# Hiring Plan — Coastal Mangrove Programme (2-Year, USD 180,000 Grant)

## 1. Assumptions (state these to your Board/ED before using the numbers)

- FX rate for planning: **USD 1 = KES 130** (re-forecast quarterly against CBK reference rate — this is your single biggest budget risk).
- Salary bands reflect typical Kenyan local-NGO norms for coastal/field programmes (Kilifi/Kwale/Lamu/Mombasa) — confirm against a current salary survey (e.g. comparator job boards, CHS Alliance data) before advertising.
- All new staff are **fixed-term contracts tied to the grant** (Employment Act 2007), renewable annually subject to performance and continued funding — build this break clause into every contract.

## 2. The budget envelope (arithmetic)

| Item | Calculation | KES |
|---|---|---|
| Total grant | 180,000 × 130 | **23,400,000** |
| Indirect cost cap (15%) | 0.15 × 23,400,000 | 3,510,000 (≈1,755,000/yr) |
| **Direct cost envelope (85%)** | 0.85 × 23,400,000 | **19,890,000** (≈9,945,000/yr) |

All programme salaries, since staff work full/part-time *on this programme only*, are **direct costs**, charged against the KES 19,890,000 — not against the 15% indirect pool. The indirect pool should instead cover: apportioned ED oversight time, shared finance/admin systems, office overhead, organisational audit, and — given you have no HR function — a contracted payroll/HR bureau.

## 3. Roles and hiring sequence

Keep the team lean; a $180k/2-year grant cannot sustain a large payroll and still deliver restoration outputs. Sequence hiring around what's needed first.

| Order | Role | FTE | Start | Duration | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Project Coordinator** | 1.0 | Month 1 | 24 mo | Anchor hire — workplan, government/KFS/KWS/NEMA/county liaison, subsequent recruitment |
| 1 (parallel) | **Finance & Compliance Officer** | 0.5 | Month 1 | 24 mo | Must be in place before funds flow — sets up grant ledgers, procurement, donor reporting |
| 2 | **Community & Field Officer** | 1.0 | Month 2 | 23 mo | Community entry, BMU/CFA mobilisation, nursery sites |
| 3 | **M&E Officer** | 0.5 | Month 4 | 21 mo | Baseline survey once field activity starts |
| 4 | **Endline Evaluation Consultant** | Short-term | Month 22–23 | 1 mo | Non-payroll professional service, close-out |

Additional field labour needed for planting/nursery maintenance should be engaged as **community cash-for-work / site promoters** (stipend-based, activity-line, not payroll) — cheaper, builds local ownership, avoids adding permanent headcount.

## 4. Gross salary bands (KES/month) and budgeted point used

| Role | Sector band (gross) | Budgeted at |
|---|---|---|
| Project Coordinator (1.0 FTE) | 150,000–180,000 | 160,000 |
| Community & Field Officer (1.0 FTE) | 55,000–85,000 | 70,000 |
| Finance & Compliance Officer (100,000 FTE band; hired at 0.5 FTE) | 80,000–120,000 | 50,000 (=0.5×100,000) |
| M&E Officer (90,000 FTE band; hired at 0.5 FTE) | 70,000–100,000 | 45,000 (=0.5×90,000) |

## 5. Statutory / quasi-statutory employer on-costs (Kenya)

| On-cost | Basis | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| NSSF (employer) | ~6% of pensionable pay, **capped** under current Tier I/II limits | Budget ≈ KES 2,160/employee/month at current cap (will rise as NSSF Act phase-in continues — see contingency below) |
| Affordable Housing Levy (employer) | 1.5% of gross, uncapped | |
| WIBA (Work Injury Benefits) insurance | ~0.75% of gross (indicative premium) | Mandatory cover, not a govt remittance but a legal obligation |
| SHIF (ex-NHIF) | 2.75% of gross | **Employee-deducted**, employer only administers — not an added employer cost |
| Gratuity/service pay | 1/12 (8.33%) of gross per year of service | Required in practice for fixed-term staff **not** in a registered pension scheme — accrue monthly |
| PAYE | Per KRA tax bands | Employee-deducted; employer's cost is administrative only |

### Personnel cost build-up (2 years)

**Gross salaries:**

| Role | Monthly gross | Months | Subtotal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Coordinator | 160,000 | 24 | 3,840,000 |
| Field Officer | 70,000 | 23 | 1,610,000 |
| Finance Officer (0.5) | 50,000 | 24 | 1,200,000 |
| M&E Officer (0.5) | 45,000 | 21 | 945,000 |
| **Total gross payroll** | | | **7,595,000** |

**On-costs:**

- NSSF: (2,160×24)+(2,160×23)+(2,160×24)+(2,160×21) = 51,840+49,680+51,840+45,360 = **198,720**
- AHL: 1.5% × 7,595,000 = **113,925**
- WIBA: 0.75% × 7,595,000 = **56,963**
- Gratuity: 7,595,000 ÷ 12 = **632,917**
- **Total on-costs = 198,720+113,925+56,963+632,917 = 1,002,525**

**Total personnel cost (2 yrs) = 7,595,000 + 1,002,525 = KES 8,597,525**

|---|---|---|
| Personnel (salary + on-costs) | 8,597,525 | 43.2% |
